title: tanacetum maximum
intro: Tanacetum maximum, commonly known as Feverfew, is a flowering plant in the daisy family, native to the Balkan Peninsula. The health benefits of Feverfew include reducing fever, relieving headaches and migraines, and treating nausea, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Feverfew are attributed to its ability to relax smooth muscles, reduce prostaglandin production, and inhibit platelet aggregation. The bioactive constituents of Feverfew include parthenolide, a sesquiterpene lactone, which is responsible for its pharmacological effects and has been shown to have antioxidant and anti-cancer properties.
